detail.longDescription: Google’s WikiSkill gives AI agents a persistent memory of past mistakes to sharpen future perfor... Google's WikiSkill framework gives AI agents persistent memory of past experiences—both successes and failures—stored in a wiki-like format. This three-layered system separates raw experience, distilled knowledge, and actionable skills, enabling AI to improve over time. Results show major performance gains in math and spreadsheet tasks, with smaller models now competing with larger ones lacking this framework. https:// the-decoder.com/google-gives-a i-agents-their-own-wiki-so-they-can-learn-from-mistakes-and-successes/ # AI # MachineLearning
